Tests that on_response hook is called with response data

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.hookOnResponseCalled())
```
